changelog:
v3.6.0 — Seamless MKV Playback + Media3 1.9.0

• Fixed: .mkv VODs and series episodes now route to libVLC instantly on play. No more silent freeze while ExoPlayer's MKV extractor gave up. Same backend from tap to first frame — no mid-movie surprise.
• Fixed: libVLC now uses FFmpeg's demuxer (:demux=avformat) — the same demuxer IPTV Smarters uses. Malformed EBML blocks in IPTV-transcoded MKVs no longer stall playback. Files that froze mid-movie now play clean through.
• Removed 'Optimizing playback for this content' overlay on initial libVLC startup. Clean, immediate playback.
• Media3 upgraded 1.2.1 → 1.9.0 with full toolchain bump (AGP 8.6.0, Gradle 8.9, compileSdk 35). Added MKV varint-error recovery for Media3 1.9.0's stricter Matroska extractor.
• MultiView temporarily gated off on known-bad MTK Fire TV Sticks (mt8695/mt8696/mt8167) pending a follow-up fix for simultaneous-decoder playback on those chipsets. 4K Sticks and Shield unaffected.
• minSdk raised 21 → 23 (drops Fire TV Stick Gen 1/2). All primary test devices (AFTSS, AFTKRT, AFTMM, Ooustick) unaffected.
